dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Features include multiple closed 'O' and open 'C' shaped contours with irregular, non-linear edge geometries. dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of small, low-intensity pixel clusters localized between the macro-annuli, particularly dense in the posterior-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric configuration defined by a central triad of macro-annuli forming an obtuse scalene triangle, with a secondary chain of smaller blobs extending towards the posterior along the dorsal midline.
